source: A2A 1.0.0 AgentSkill (https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/main/docs/specification.md): id, name, description required; tags, examples, inputModes, outputModes optional.
description: A2A skills for the agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json. Each skill covers whole tool groups; the card lists only skills whose groups the requesting principal may use. Tool-level examples come from catalog a2a.example.

skills.name: IPFS node status
skills.description: Report the connected Kubo node's identity, server status, peers, bandwidth and repository; run garbage collection with human approval.

skills.name: IPFS content
skills.description: Add and read UnixFS content, IPLD DAG nodes and CAR files on the connected node. Writes need human approval.

skills.name: IPFS pinning
skills.description: List, verify, add, update and remove pins. Changes need human approval.

skills.name: IPFS files (MFS)
skills.description: Browse and change the node's Mutable File System. Changes need human approval.

skills.name: IPNS names and keys
skills.description: Resolve and publish IPNS names and manage keystore keys without exporting key material. Changes need human approval.

skills.name: IPFS routing
skills.description: Find providers and peers and announce CIDs (announcing needs human approval and respects the node's Provide settings).

skills.name: IPFS content search
skills.description: Semantic search over content indexed by ipfs mcp when embeddings are configured.
